subject: Supplier activation: Procurely onboarding & PO setup
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood-inference.com>
To: Jamie Cross <jamie.cross@procurely.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Supplier activation: Procurely onboarding & PO setup

Hi Jamie —

Thanks for partnering with Redwood. To get Procurely set up in our procurement system and issue the first PO, I’ve attached our standard onboarding checklist (Redwood_Onboarding_Checklist_20270411.pdf). Can you please confirm the items below and return any completed forms you have by end of next week?

What we need from you (vendor -> Redwood):
- Completed W-9 (or applicable tax form) — PDF
- Bank remittance / ACH details (vendor form or voided check)
- Certificate of insurance (GL and professional liability)
- Primary invoice contact + AP email, billing address
- Copy of signed Master Services Agreement (if already executed)
- Any region-specific compliance docs (data processing addendum if applicable)

What you can expect from us (Redwood -> vendor):
- PO issuance within 3 business days after vendor record creation and approved pricing
- Payment terms: standard NET30 unless a different term is agreed and approved by Finance
- A single point of contact in Procurement: Laura Bennett (cc’d)
- Our finance contact for vendor onboarding: Vivek Kulkarni (copied once we have bank info)

Notes / next steps:
- If you have DocuSign links for the MSA or tax docs, send them over and we’ll route internally.
- If anything is marked confidential, let us know and we’ll set appropriate handling.

Attachments: Redwood_Onboarding_Checklist_20270411.pdf (checklist + sample vendor form)

Appreciate a quick confirmation of receipt and an estimated date for the items above.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood-inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0176

Outstanding:
- Insurance certificate is expiring next week; we can send renewed COI by Wednesday 4/14.
- Our MSA was executed via DocuSign last quarter — I’ll include the envelope link if needed.

Questions for Redwood:
1) Do you require invoices to reference a Redwood PO number in a specific field? (we can include PO# in both header and line items)
2) Is NET30 your default for first-time vendors or is a credit check required to get NET30?

We’ll send the COI and MSA link by EOD Wednesday.

Thanks,

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier activation: Procurely onboarding & PO setup

Jamie —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments. Confirmed we received the W-9 and bank remittance. A couple answers below and a short timeline so everyone is aligned.

Answers:
- PO handling: please put the Redwood PO number in the invoice header field \"Invoice Reference / PO\" and also include it on the first line item. That covers our AP extraction rules.
- NET30: our default is NET30 after vendor record creation; Finance may request a quick credit/AML review for new partners, but that typically does not delay first PO. Vivek (cc’d) can confirm if any additional steps are needed for Procurely.

Proposed onboarding timeline:
- 4/13: Procurement to ingest vendor record (we have the W-9 + bank remittance)
- 4/14: Redwood issues preliminary PO (PO will be emailed to Procurely AP and appear in Redwood vendor portal)
- 4/14–4/16: Vendor confirms COI + MSA link; Finance finalizes NET30 setup

Can you send the COI and DocuSign MSA link when available. If you want faster payment terms for the first invoice, flag that in your reply and we’ll escalate to Finance for consideration.

For transparency, attachment list we uploaded into our procurement ticket: Procurely_Signed_W9.pdf, Procurely_Bank_Remittance.pdf (I also added a link to the DocuSign placeholder so we have tracking).

Thanks — Laura will kick off the vendor record intake. Vivek, please advise if you need any additional vendor credit info.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
